name: serve
description: Start a local web server in background (background command example).
help:
Serve the examples/site folder over HTTP in background.

Relative paths are resolved from the cy folder.

Aliases:
sv

Controls:
cy serve --start
cy serve --status
cy serve --stop
cy serve --restart

Parameters:
- Use -p/--port to change the port (default: 8000).
- Use -b/--bind to change the bind address (default: 127.0.0.1).

Examples:
cy serve
cy sv --start -p 8080
cy sv --status
cy sv --stop

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8000/
